description: The race car: health and tires, damage, wrecking, enter/exit, item use; driving and cameras come from the Sedan template.

functions.name: InitTires
functions.doc: Four fresh tires at TireMaxHealth (the wheels show their tyres again).

functions.name: RefreshWheels
functions.doc: Each wheel shows RimMesh while its tyre is blown, else WheelMesh (Tires index i is the i-th wheel: FL, FR, RL, RR).

functions.name: ApplyPaint
functions.doc: PaintMaterial, when set, on the Body's PaintSlot (BeginPlay; SpawnNPCs after giving a rival the gang paint).

functions.name: RefreshRoofWeapon
functions.doc: The roof weapon shows the driver's held weapon: SM_DF_RoofLauncher while its racer holds an RPG, else SM_DF_RoofGun while it holds a Gun, else hidden (also with no driver or outside a race). Called after ApplyItem, on GrantItem and respawn, and on Enter/Exit.

functions.name: GetSpeedKPH
functions.doc: Absolute forward speed in km/h.

functions.name: GetGearString
functions.doc: R, N or the gear number for the HUD.

functions.name: GetBlownTireCount
functions.doc: How many tires are blown.

functions.name: GetThrottleScale
functions.doc: BlownTireSpeedScale to the power of the blown tire count.

functions.name: IsBelowExitSpeed
functions.doc: Slow enough to get out.

functions.name: CanBeEntered
functions.doc: No occupant and not wrecked.

functions.name: FindTireIndexForHit
functions.doc: The tire hit: by wheel bone, else the nearest wheel socket within TireHitRadius; -1 for the body.

functions.name: ApplyTireDamage
functions.doc: Takes health off one tire; at 0 it is blown, the count and OnTireBlown update and the wheel shows its rim.

functions.name: BlowNearestTire
functions.doc: Explosion tire blast on the wheel nearest the point (skipped when wrecked or shielded).

functions.name: TakeDamageInternal
functions.doc: Routes damage to a tire or the body (ignored while shielded or wrecked); the body at 0 wrecks the car.

functions.name: DestroyVehicle
functions.doc: Wrecks the car once: handbrake, charred paint and trim, hop, smoke, effects-only explosion, OnVehicleDestroyed, the GameMode notified.

functions.name: TeleportAndStop
functions.doc: Clears the drive state, cuts the camera lag for a frame, moves the car and zeroes its velocity (respawns, resets and tests).

functions.name: CanExit
functions.doc: An occupant, not wrecked, below the exit speed.

functions.name: IsExitSpotFree
functions.doc: Capsule trace at a spot beside the car.

functions.name: FindExitLocation
functions.doc: Left door, then right, then behind the car.

functions.name: EnterVehicle
functions.doc: The character gets in: stowed, its controller possesses the car, OnOccupantEntered.

functions.name: ExitVehicle
functions.doc: The driver gets out beside the car and the controller possesses the character.

functions.name: EjectOccupant
functions.doc: Puts the occupant beside the car without changing possession (respawn).

functions.name: TickDriveOverrides
functions.doc: Per-frame input: parked or wrecked cars brake; blown tires cap the throttle; the player's steering is smoothed and scaled with speed; writes the inputs the arcade layer reads (ArcadeSteer/Throttle/Handbrake).

functions.name: ComputeDriveThrottle
functions.doc: Input x ThrottleScale; 0 when accelerating at or above TopSpeedKPH (0 = no limiter).

functions.name: ComputeSteerScale
functions.doc: lerp(1, SteerAtSpeed, clamp(SpeedKPH / SteerSpeedRef, 0, 1)): less steering at speed.

functions.name: SmoothSteer
functions.doc: Moves Current toward Target at SteerRiseRate when Target is larger and on the same side, else at SteerReturnRate; never overshoots.

functions.name: ComputeDownforce
functions.doc: min(DownforceG x 980 x (SpeedKPH / 100)^2, DownforceCap) in cm/s^2.

functions.name: ComputeGripAccel
functions.doc: -LateralSpeed x GripAssist (x DriftGrip while drifting): the sideways grip acceleration.

functions.name: ComputeTargetFOV
functions.doc: 90 + 15 x clamp(SpeedKPH / 160, 0, 1) + 8 while boosting.

functions.name: ComputeEnginePitch
functions.doc: 0.6 + 1.4 x clamp(RPMRatio, 0, 1).

functions.name: LimitDamping
functions.doc: Caps a damping acceleration at |Value| / DeltaSeconds, so one long frame never reverses Value.

functions.name: IsGrounded
functions.doc: A Visibility line trace from the actor origin GroundProbe cm straight down hits (self ignored).

functions.name: UpdateDrift
functions.doc: Drift starts with the handbrake, |Steer| >= DriftSteerMin, SpeedKPH >= DriftMinSpeed and grounded; it ends on a handbrake release, below DriftExitSpeed or airborne. A release after DriftBoostMinSeconds kicks the car forward by DriftBoostSpeed (DriftBoostCount, OnDriftBoost).

functions.name: TickArcade
functions.doc: Per-frame arcade handling: ground probe and drift state; the handbrake input (held, but not while drifting); grounded: grip assist, downforce, stability or drift yaw; airborne past AirDelay: pitch/roll damping, levelling, and air control for the player's car.

functions.name: SetAIInput
functions.doc: The AI controller's inputs; TickDriveOverrides applies them every frame while bAIControlled.

functions.name: TickTyreSmoke
functions.doc: Spec §5.5: on the ground and drifting or sliding (|lateral speed| > TyreSmokeLateral), a BP_DFFxPuff at each rear wheel every TyreSmokeInterval, only within 8000 cm of the player's camera (GameMode.IsNearPlayerView; Review Focus 2).

functions.name: SpawnWreckSmoke
functions.doc: The wreck's looping timer (every WreckSmokeInterval from DestroyVehicle): a BP_DFFxPuff darkened by WreckSmokeTint over the WreckFire while within 8000 cm of the player's camera; the timer stops if the car is no longer wrecked.

functions.name: PlayDriverShake
functions.doc: Plays a camera shake on the driver's view when a player drives this car (an AI driver has no view).

functions.name: ShowDriverDamage
functions.doc: The damage vignette (WBP_DFRaceHUD.ShowDamage) on the race HUD of the player driving this car.

functions.name: ResetCar
functions.doc: Spec §5.2: below ResetMaxSpeed km/h over the ground and ResetCooldown s after the last reset, the car is lifted ResetLift cm with pitch and roll zeroed and its velocities zeroed (TeleportAndStop): no death, no position gain. Refused (false) otherwise, and for a wreck.

functions.name: SetLookBack
functions.doc: Look-back (spec §5.3): the spring arm turns to the rear (ArmBaseRotation + 180 degrees of yaw) or back to the chase view; the turn is a cut, not a swing (the arm's rotation lag is off until TickCamera's next frame).

functions.name: ClearDriveState
functions.doc: Ends look-back (the arm faces forward again), any drift (no boost), the smoothed steer and the held handbrake. Called on exit, on TeleportAndStop (respawns, resets) and on pause, where a key release can be missed.

functions.name: TickCamera
functions.doc: A player's car only: the chase camera's FOV moves toward ComputeTargetFOV(speed, boosting) at FOVInterpSpeed /s (spec §5.3); the spring arm's rotation and location lag come back on the frame after a look-back or teleport cut.

functions.name: TickAudio
functions.doc: Spec §5.4, every frame: EngineAudio's pitch = ComputeEnginePitch(engine rpm / max rpm) and its volume = 0.35 + 0.65 x |throttle input| (clamped to 1), 0 for a parked or wrecked car (engine off) [call]; SkidAudio's volume = clamp((|lateral speed| - 300) / 700, 0, 1) on the ground, 0 in the air.

functions.name: HandleCrashHit
functions.doc: Spec §5.4: a hit whose normal impulse is above CrashImpulse, at least CrashCooldown s after the last crash, plays CrashSound at the contact and gives the driver a light camera shake (§5.3). Returns whether it did.

functions.name: IsShielded
functions.doc: A shield is running.

functions.name: ActivateBoost
functions.doc: Starts the boost timer and kicks the car forward.

functions.name: ActivateShield
functions.doc: Starts the shield timer (the shield-up sound; the bubble shows at once).

functions.name: ClearEffects
functions.doc: Ends boost and shield (silently: a restart or a respawn, not the shield running out).

functions.name: RefreshEffectLook
functions.doc: BoostFlameL/R show while BoostRemaining > 0 and ShieldBubble while IsShielded(); the shield's end (shown, now not shielded) plays ShieldDownSound.

functions.name: ShieldHit
functions.doc: A blocked hit: ShieldHitSound, and the bubble glows ShieldHitGlow for ShieldHitSeconds.

functions.name: EndShieldHit
functions.doc: The bubble's flash is over: its own glow again (ShieldBaseGlow).

functions.name: TickEffects
functions.doc: Per-frame boost force; both effect timers run down; the flames and the bubble follow them (RefreshEffectLook).

functions.name: CanUseItem
functions.doc: The gun waits for its cooldown; every other item is always usable.

functions.name: GetMuzzleLocation
functions.doc: In front of the bumper, above the hood.

functions.name: GetAimDirection
functions.doc: Where a shot goes: at AimTarget's centre (60 cm up) when an AI set one, else straight ahead.

functions.name: FireGun
functions.doc: One hitscan shot from the muzzle along the aim direction, credited to the driver.

functions.name: FireRPG
functions.doc: Launches a rocket from the muzzle (short of anything blocking it), credited to the driver.

functions.name: ApplyItem
functions.doc: Runs an item's effect on this car.

functions.name: DropBomb
functions.doc: Drops a bomb behind the car, credited to the driver.

functions.name: UseSelectedItem
functions.doc: Consumes and applies the driver's selected item; refused when wrecked, empty or on cooldown.

functions.name: CycleItem
functions.doc: Selects the driver's next inventory slot.
